architecture.summary: Documents and an operator tool only. SO-12 part B records the rehearsal in docs/implementation/self-onboarding-s2-release.md: the application checks of section 1.4, the preflight R0, the Git build of the staging control plane R1, which failed in the check stage of Dockerfile.hosted on the builder of Render (one timing-dependent acceptance case of 222), the stop at that failed check, the cleanup, and the Part B findings. It adds the rehearsal helper script/release/rehearsal/ (the create of the staging control plane, its variables, the OAuth resource, the WorkOS objects of the run, the Connect tokens, the MCP calls, the portal steps, and the reads of the staging database), its knip entry and its section in script/README.md, and one row in the Containers and source owners table of architecture/components.md. The helper is outside src and no component: it composes the public bounded SQL runtime of sql and the hosted live test support, and calls the Render and WorkOS APIs itself. No source, test, workflow, migration, or Mermaid block changes, so no component, edge, public module, declaration, or runtime behavior of a server changes.
